column1: PL24 reviewed — adoption stalled in the 68–72% range for 3 months. Sabine confirmed staff use phone for complex or urgent orders as no digital exception process exists.
Order mix analysis done — 40% of orders are commodity items with sub-18% margin. Premium wear parts are heavily under-indexed.
AOS basket reviewed — 3 premium families missing for 5-series and 7-series vehicles. Sabine agreed to add them this week.
Agreed Q2 focus areas — PL24 digital exception-handling process and premium parts recommendation coaching.
